name: Exhaustion fade: an extreme day's move faded from 14:00 to the close — mean-reverting tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: On extreme days late chasers and dealers' hedging rebalance into the close against the day's move. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_new_angles.md). Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).
